summary: Iter 8 (Final Product Update: map radar + plan-based radius + plan-confirmed + review-setup + high-density demo). Frontend-only verification at 390x800. RESULT: 10 of 11 review flows PASS; 1 flow shows a Nearby-tab data-refresh anomaly worth investigating. Verified as Kauri (Pro, radius 250m): radar-map renders with rings 50/100/175/250, testIDs current-vibe-pill + visibility-toggle + radar-radius-chip + radar-filters + radar-recentre + privacy-learn-more all present. radar-radius-chip text 'Radius: 250m'; opening the sheet shows radius-sheet-10/25/50/100/250/500 all unlocked for Pro (no Plus/Pro lock tag). Marker preview works: tapping a radar-blip-<id> opens testID marker-preview with name/age/vibe/distance + preview-view-profile + preview-close (screenshot 20). privacy-learn-more navigates to /location-privacy (testID location-privacy-screen) with title 'You control your location' + all 6 cards including 'Extended discovery stays private' + button label 'I understand' (testID privacy-got-it) — returns to radar on tap. extended-radius-note visible at 250m; stats card shows Nearby / Aligned / Radius labels (screenshot 23: '100+ / 42 / 250m' when HD on); see-more-nearby button present. Locked radii (Sarah, Free plan, max_radius=50): sheet shows 100m/250m/500m with correct 'Plus'/'Pro' lock tags (verified in inner text). Demo plan switcher: switching Sarah to Plus updated radius chip to 'Radius: 100m' immediately. High-Density Demo: after toggle-high-density ON as Kauri Pro, Radar shows Nearby=100+, Aligned=42, Radius=250m, 21 radar-cluster-* bubbles (max 24), testID high-density-card visible with why-limit link. Signup flow back buttons present (verified via code + DOM): how-location-back, location-privacy-back, plans-back, review-back all render. /plan-confirmed screen fully wired: testID plan-confirmed-screen, plan-radar-preview mini map, plan-confirmed-continue, edit-setup-link → /review-setup which shows testID review-setup-screen with all 6 rows (review-edit-plan/radius/vibe/details/visibility/availability) + start-using-intro button. Wording regression PASS: 'Maximum 100 metres', 'Within 100m only', 'never shows users beyond 100m', '100m maximum', 'Maximum 100m' NOT found on any of location-privacy, how-location-works, onboarding screens. ONE ISSUE: Nearby tab did NOT render '100+ people nearby · Showing the best 100...' header nor nearby-cap-note footer even though Radar (same AppContext.nearby data) was showing 100+/42 people just before navigation — the Nearby tab showed 'No one nearby right now' empty state instead. Code in nearby.tsx (line 63-64, 125-126) is correct; the bug is that AppContext.nearby appears to reset to 0 on tab navigation. Deprecated packages: NONE. Carry-over cosmetic RN-Web warnings: 'shadow*' style props and 'props.pointerEvents' still emit console warnings (already reported in iter_5/6/7).

ui_bugs.issue: After enabling High-Density Demo, Radar shows 100+/42 with 21 cluster bubbles, but navigating to the Nearby tab (same AppContext.nearby array) shows the empty-state 'No one nearby right now' and neither the '100+ people nearby · Showing the best 100...' header (line 64) nor testID nearby-cap-note footer (line 126) render. Header/footer logic keys off nearby.length>=100; nearby.length is somehow 0 by the time Nearby tab mounts. Suspect: AppContext refresh() being triggered on tab focus resets HD-injected users because the Nearby endpoint response no longer includes them, OR HD injection is only applied on the Radar path.

integration_issues.issue: Same as above — Radar HD data does not persist into the Nearby tab render.

Carry-over: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warning. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/RadarView.tsx:182,192,213,225,236

action_items: Investigate why Nearby tab shows empty state while Radar simultaneously shows 100+ people during High-Density Demo. Likely AppContext.nearby is refreshed by /api/nearby on focus and HD injection is applied only in the Radar code path (or on initial fetch). Fix so HD injected users are present in the same array both tabs read from, OR make Nearby tab call the HD-aware fetch. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/nearby.tsx:60-66 + wherever HD injection lives in AppContext.

OPTIONAL (Low, carry-over): Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts to silence Expo Web console warnings; migrate props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents in RadarView.tsx.

rca_of_issue: HD Nearby empty-state bug: reproduction — as Kauri Pro, Profile → Demo Accounts → toggle-high-density ON → Radar loads (shows 100+/42 with 21 clusters) → tap Nearby tab → shows 'No one nearby right now' and Within Nm sub-text. Expected: '100+ people nearby · Showing the best 100...' header + nearby-cap-note footer. Both tabs read the same AppContext.nearby array. Likely cause: the HD injection code injects synthetic hd-* users into AppContext.nearby only for the Radar mount path, or refresh() on Nearby focus overwrites the array with a non-HD backend fetch. Suggested fix: move HD injection into the AppContext.refresh() function (based on user.high_density_demo) so both tabs receive the injected users on every refresh, OR pass through the /api/nearby endpoint with a high_density_demo=true query so backend injects them consistently.
